annotation.interpretation_a: Implementations must not use the 'hq' identifier at any time before the RFC is published.
annotation.interpretation_b: Implementations must not use the 'hq' identifier only while a draft version of the RFC is in development; once a draft is published, they may use it.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'Until such an RFC exists' is open to interpretation. It's unclear whether it refers to the publication of *any* RFC, or specifically the final, published RFC. This affects when implementations are permitted to use the identifier.
annotation.missing_information: The duration of 'Until such an RFC exists' is not defined. Does it mean 'until the RFC is published', or 'until a draft version is published'?
